subject.title: fix(repair): rank cluster candidates for landable bugs

question: Should the repair lane adopt these candidate-ranking and live-fence rejection rules as the policy foundation for the dependent durable-intake stack?
rationale: The patch is not a narrow bug repair: it establishes operational policy for which reported clusters are eligible for automated planning, and its downstream stack relies on that contract.

options.title: Accept the selection boundary
options.body: Review the ranking criteria and controlled live-fence behavior, then merge this base layer before the dependent intake PRs.

options.title: Narrow the policy first
options.body: Retain only the rejection signals maintainers want in production and request a revised base layer before reviewing dependent work.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Defer the durable-intake rollout until production selection criteria and acceptance evidence are agreed.

recommendation.title: Accept the selection boundary
recommendation.body: Review the ranking criteria and controlled live-fence behavior, then merge this base layer before the dependent intake PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the connected candidate-selection and durable-intake stack and can clarify the intended cross-layer contract.
